purpose: Source-bind the current public Binance Spot Block Matching mechanism, fee schedule, eligibility, settlement, and API security classes before any economic claim.

decision_rule.candidate: Current primary sources must prove off-book execution, exact maker and taker fees, master-account whitelisting, allowed-price bounds, and immediate settlement. The mechanism may remain only a conditional cost-saving candidate when an independently required bilateral Spot trade has an exact negotiated price that is cheaper than the executable public-book counterfactual after account fees and all costs.
decision_rule.reject: Reject any public positive-profit floor if exact account eligibility, pair, size, negotiated price, counterparty, counterfactual depth, account fees, settlement, or realized owned fill is absent.
